items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: Manuel Perez was one. ... when Manuel Perez played a sweet trumpet, nice, beautiful trumpet.

ctx.x: I was going to ask one more question before we quit, if, unless there's something else particularly you wanted to add. I was going to ask if there are any early trumpet players when you first started out that you admired and copied more than any of you? That is not necessarily copied, but I mean, as you heard when you were a boy that you, what was the greatest when you were a kid?
Well, King Oliver was one. Manuel Perez was one.
